description: Shared 24-question dataset for final-system end-to-end evaluation and role-based UAT. The same questions are evaluated technically using traces and LLM-as-a-Judge, then by users using acceptance metrics.

cases.question: Tampilkan ringkasan performa akademik untuk salah satu kelas yang saya ampu, mencakup jumlah mahasiswa, distribusi nilai, kehadiran mahasiswa, dan indikator evaluasi utama.

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a lecturer account that has at least one visible taught class with grade distribution and evaluation data.

prohibited_behavior: showing classes outside the lecturer scope

task_success_criteria: The answer identifies a class in the lecturer scope.
The answer reports academic performance using multiple indicators, not only evaluation score.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare the stated indicators with SQL tool output.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: All numeric claims must be supported by tool observations.
completeness_criteria: Includes grade distribution or graded-student count.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you use this answer to understand the academic condition of one class you teach?
acceptance_rubric.perceived_correctness_prompt: The answer appears factually reasonable for my class data.
acceptance_rubric.usefulness_prompt: The answer helps me identify whether the class needs follow-up.
acceptance_rubric.clarity_prompt: The answer is easy to understand.
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this type of answer as academic monitoring support.

pre_uat_checks: The selected class belongs to the lecturer scope.

cases.notes_for_evaluator: This case tests broader academic performance, not only course evaluation score.

cases.question: Kelas yang saya ampu mana yang memiliki indikasi performa akademik paling perlu diperhatikan berdasarkan kehadiran mahasiswa, distribusi nilai, atau skor evaluasi?

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a lecturer account with more than one visible class if possible.

prohibited_behavior: using only one indicator when multiple indicators are available

task_success_criteria: The answer prioritizes at least one class.
The prioritization is justified using academic indicators.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare class ranking and indicators with SQL output.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: Priority reasoning must be traceable to retrieved indicators.
completeness_criteria: Mentions attendance, grade distribution, or evaluation score.
Explains why the class is prioritized.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you identify which class needs attention from this answer?
acceptance_rubric.perceived_correctness_prompt: The prioritization appears consistent with the data.
acceptance_rubric.usefulness_prompt: The answer helps me decide where to focus follow-up.
acceptance_rubric.clarity_prompt: The priority and reason are clearly explained.
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would trust this answer as an initial warning signal.

pre_uat_checks: Evidence contains at least one visible class.

cases.notes_for_evaluator: If the lecturer has only one class, evaluate whether the answer still explains the class condition rather than forcing a ranking.

cases.question: Tampilkan ringkasan metode perkuliahan dan sistem penilaian dari portofolio salah satu kelas yang saya ampu.

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a lecturer account with at least one visible portfolio entry.

task_success_criteria: The answer summarizes teaching method and assessment system.
The summary is grounded in portfolio text.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare summary against retrieved portfolio text.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: No statement should go beyond portfolio evidence.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you understand how the class was conducted and assessed from this answer?
acceptance_rubric.perceived_correctness_prompt: The summary matches what I expect from the portfolio.
acceptance_rubric.usefulness_prompt: The answer helps me review my portfolio entry.
acceptance_rubric.clarity_prompt: The summary is concise and understandable.
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this summary to review portfolio documentation.

pre_uat_checks: Answer does not fabricate missing text.

cases.notes_for_evaluator: Accept either SQL-based portfolio retrieval or RAG retrieval if the final evidence is grounded.

cases.question: Ringkas refleksi pelaksanaan perkuliahan dan usulan perbaikan dosen untuk salah satu kelas yang saya ampu.

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a lecturer account with reflection and improvement-plan text.

prohibited_behavior: creating recommendations not present in evidence without labeling them as interpretation

task_success_criteria: The answer summarizes reflection and improvement plan.
The answer separates evidence summary from interpretation.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare summary with portfolio evidence.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: Summary claims must be grounded in retrieved text.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you use this answer to review reflection and follow-up plans?
acceptance_rubric.perceived_correctness_prompt: The answer reflects the portfolio content accurately.
acceptance_rubric.usefulness_prompt: The answer helps me evaluate what to improve next.
acceptance_rubric.clarity_prompt: The reflection and improvement points are clear.
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this answer as a review aid.

pre_uat_checks: The answer contains both reflection and improvement components.

cases.question: Bandingkan skor kelas yang saya ampu antara dua semester terakhir yang tersedia.

user_scope.scope_notes: Prefer a lecturer account with class data in at least two semesters.

task_success_criteria: The answer compares two available semesters.
The answer states direction of change.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare trend claims with SQL output.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: Trend statements must be derived from observed scores.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you understand whether class performance improved or declined?
acceptance_rubric.perceived_correctness_prompt: The comparison appears consistent with the data.
acceptance_rubric.usefulness_prompt: The comparison helps me reflect on semester-to-semester changes.
acceptance_rubric.clarity_prompt: The comparison is easy to follow.
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would trust this comparison as monitoring support.

pre_uat_checks: At least two semesters are available or the answer states that comparison is not possible.

cases.question: Berdasarkan skor evaluasi dan isi portofolio, aspek apa yang paling perlu saya perbaiki pada kelas yang saya ampu?

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a lecturer account with both score data and portfolio text.

task_success_criteria: The answer identifies an improvement area.
The answer uses both numeric and textual evidence.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare identified weak indicators with SQL evidence and portfolio text.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: Recommendation must be traceable to evidence.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you identify what to improve from this answer?
acceptance_rubric.perceived_correctness_prompt: The diagnosis feels consistent with my class context.
acceptance_rubric.usefulness_prompt: The recommendation is useful for teaching improvement.
acceptance_rubric.clarity_prompt: The reasoning and recommendation are clear.
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this answer as decision-support, not as final judgment.

pre_uat_checks: SQL and portfolio evidence are both present.
The recommendation is phrased as support, not absolute judgment.

cases.notes_for_evaluator: This is one of the most important UAT cases because it tests integrated analytical value.

cases.question: Tampilkan lima kelas di prodi saya yang perlu diprioritaskan berdasarkan performa akademik, termasuk distribusi nilai, kehadiran, dan skor evaluasi.

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a program-head account with active program scope.

task_success_criteria: The answer ranks or prioritizes classes.
The answer uses more than one academic indicator.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare class indicators and scope with SQL output.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: Prioritization must follow available evidence.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you identify which classes in the program need follow-up?
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this as an initial monitoring aid.

pre_uat_checks: Answer is not only a KPI list.

cases.question: Untuk kelas dengan performa akademik yang perlu diperhatikan di prodi saya, ringkas refleksi dosen dan usulan perbaikannya.

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a program-head account with visible class portfolio entries.

task_success_criteria: The answer first identifies relevant classes then summarizes portfolio evidence.
The answer stays within program scope.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare class selection with SQL output and summary with portfolio text.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: Reflection and improvement claims must be supported by text evidence.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you understand why the class needs attention and what the lecturer proposed?
acceptance_rubric.perceived_correctness_prompt: The summary appears consistent with program data.
acceptance_rubric.usefulness_prompt: The answer helps me prepare program-level follow-up.
acceptance_rubric.clarity_prompt: The selected class and summary are clear.
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this answer for initial monitoring discussion.

pre_uat_checks: SQL evidence and portfolio evidence are both available.
No class outside program scope appears.

cases.question: Di prodi saya, indikator akademik mana yang paling perlu diperhatikan pada semester terakhir yang tersedia jika mempertimbangkan skor capaian, pelaksanaan, sarana prasarana, perilaku mahasiswa, dan kehadiran?

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a program-head account.

task_success_criteria: The answer identifies an indicator needing attention.
The answer uses cross-indicator interpretation.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare indicator values with SQL output.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: Interpretation must be grounded in indicator values.
completeness_criteria: Explains why one indicator is prioritized.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you identify which program indicator needs attention?
acceptance_rubric.usefulness_prompt: The answer helps program monitoring beyond dashboard reading.
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this as monitoring support.

pre_uat_checks: Answer includes interpretation, not only raw values.

cases.notes_for_evaluator: This replaces a dashboard-only KPI question.

cases.question: Tampilkan rata-rata skor capaian, pelaksanaan, sarana prasarana, perilaku mahasiswa, dan keseluruhan untuk prodi saya.

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a program-head account.

task_success_criteria: The answer reports program-level indicators.
The answer includes the evaluated period.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare program indicators with SQL output.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: All values must be supported by SQL observations.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you understand the program indicator profile from this answer?
acceptance_rubric.usefulness_prompt: The answer helps me monitor program performance.
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this output as monitoring support.

cases.question: Bandingkan skor evaluasi mahasiswa untuk prodi saya antara dua semester terakhir yang tersedia.

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a program-head account with at least two semesters of data.

task_success_criteria: The answer compares two available semesters.
The answer states whether the trend improves or declines.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare trend values with SQL output.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: Trend claims must be supported by data.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you understand the program trend from this answer?
acceptance_rubric.perceived_correctness_prompt: The trend appears consistent with the data.
acceptance_rubric.clarity_prompt: The comparison is easy to follow.
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this trend as monitoring input.

pre_uat_checks: Two periods are available or limitation is clearly stated.

cases.question: Berdasarkan kuesioner evaluasi, dosen atau kelas mana yang perlu mendapat perhatian terlebih dahulu?

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a program-head account.

prohibited_behavior: identifying individual lecturers without supporting evidence

task_success_criteria: The answer identifies a priority target.
The answer explains the evidence for attention.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare priority evidence with SQL and portfolio observations.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: Diagnosis must remain evidence-bound.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you decide what needs attention first from this answer?
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this answer as initial decision support.

pre_uat_checks: Answer does not make unsupported personal judgments.

cases.notes_for_evaluator: If privacy-sensitive lecturer identification is a concern, judge whether the answer uses class-level priority instead.

cases.question: Tampilkan kelas di fakultas saya yang perlu diprioritaskan berdasarkan performa akademik, termasuk nilai, kehadiran, dan indikator evaluasi.

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a faculty-level account with kd_fak scope.

task_success_criteria: The answer identifies priority classes within faculty scope.
The answer uses academic-performance indicators.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare selected classes and indicators with SQL output.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: Priority reasoning must be supported by evidence.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you identify faculty-level classes needing attention?
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this as initial faculty monitoring support.

cases.question: Ringkas pola usulan perbaikan dari portofolio beberapa kelas dengan skor rendah di fakultas saya.

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a faculty-level account with visible portfolio entries.

prohibited_behavior: portfolio summary without explaining selected class basis

task_success_criteria: The answer selects relevant low-score classes.
The answer summarizes improvement patterns from portfolio evidence.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare low-score selection with SQL output and summary with portfolio text.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: Pattern summary must be grounded in retrieved portfolio text.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you understand common improvement themes in the faculty?
acceptance_rubric.perceived_correctness_prompt: The pattern summary appears consistent with portfolio content.
acceptance_rubric.usefulness_prompt: The answer helps faculty-level quality improvement discussion.
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this answer as preparation for follow-up.

cases.question: Tampilkan rata-rata skor overall setiap prodi di fakultas saya pada semester terakhir yang tersedia.

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a faculty-level account.

task_success_criteria: The answer reports program-level scores for the faculty.
The evaluated semester is stated.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare program rows with SQL output.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: All values must come from SQL evidence.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you monitor program-level scores from this answer?
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this table-like output as monitoring support.

cases.question: Prodi mana di fakultas saya yang memiliki rata-rata kehadiran mahasiswa terendah?

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a faculty-level account.

task_success_criteria: The answer identifies the program with lowest average student attendance.
The answer reports the attendance value or rank basis.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare lowest program with SQL output.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: Ranking must be supported by SQL evidence.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you identify the program needing attendance follow-up?
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would trust this as an initial signal.

cases.question: Bandingkan tren skor overall antarprodi di fakultas saya dalam dua semester terakhir yang tersedia.

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a faculty-level account with at least two semesters of program statistics.

task_success_criteria: The answer compares programs across two semesters.
The answer identifies trend direction.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare trend values with SQL output.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: All trend claims must be data-supported.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you compare program trends from this answer?
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this as monitoring input.

cases.question: Berdasarkan data evaluasi dan portofolio, prodi atau kelas mana yang perlu mendapat perhatian fakultas terlebih dahulu?

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a faculty-level account.

task_success_criteria: The answer identifies a priority target.
The answer combines evaluation data with portfolio evidence.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare priority evidence with SQL output and retrieved text.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: Recommendation must be evidence-grounded.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you decide what needs faculty attention first?
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this as decision-support.

pre_uat_checks: Numeric and text evidence are both available.

cases.question: Tampilkan kelas di tingkat institut yang perlu diprioritaskan berdasarkan performa akademik, termasuk nilai, kehadiran, dan indikator evaluasi.

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a directorate-level account with institution-wide scope.

task_success_criteria: The answer identifies institution-level priority classes.
The answer uses academic indicators.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare indicators with SQL output.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: Priority claims must be evidence-based.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you identify institution-level classes needing attention?
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this as monitoring support.

pre_uat_checks: No artificial scope restriction blocks institution-level view.

cases.question: Tampilkan rata-rata skor overall setiap fakultas pada semester terakhir yang tersedia.

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a directorate-level account.

task_success_criteria: The answer aggregates by faculty.
The answer reports overall score.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare faculty aggregation with SQL output.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: All values must be supported by SQL.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you monitor faculty-level scores from this answer?
acceptance_rubric.clarity_prompt: The output is easy to read.
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this as monitoring support.

pre_uat_checks: Values are grounded in SQL output.

cases.question: Fakultas mana yang memiliki rata-rata kehadiran mahasiswa terendah pada semester terakhir yang tersedia?

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a directorate-level account.

task_success_criteria: The answer identifies a faculty with lowest attendance.
The answer reports the evidence value.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare ranking with SQL output.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: The lowest-faculty claim must be SQL-supported.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you identify the faculty needing attendance follow-up?
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this as an initial monitoring signal.

cases.question: Bandingkan tren skor overall antar fakultas dalam dua semester terakhir yang tersedia.

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a directorate-level account.

task_success_criteria: The answer compares faculties across two semesters.
The answer states trend direction.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare trend with SQL output.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: Trend claims must be supported by data.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you compare faculty trends from this answer?
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this as monitoring support.

cases.question: Identifikasi prodi dengan penurunan skor overall terbesar antar dua semester terakhir yang tersedia.

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a directorate-level account.

task_success_criteria: The answer identifies programs with largest decline.
The answer reports the amount or direction of decline.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare identified decline with SQL output.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: Decline claims must be calculated from evidence.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you identify the program needing trend follow-up?
acceptance_rubric.usefulness_prompt: The answer helps prioritize institution-level review.
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this as initial prioritization support.

cases.question: Berdasarkan data lintas fakultas, area akademik mana yang perlu diprioritaskan untuk evaluasi lanjutan dan apa bukti pendukungnya?

user_scope.scope_notes: Run using a directorate-level account.

task_success_criteria: The answer identifies an institution-level priority area.
The answer provides evidence and a follow-up recommendation.
technical_rubric.correctness_reference: Compare evidence with SQL and retrieved text.
technical_rubric.faithfulness_reference: Recommendation must be grounded and cautious.

acceptance_rubric.task_completion_prompt: Can you identify what should be evaluated further?
acceptance_rubric.trust_acceptance_prompt: I would use this as decision-support for further review.

pre_uat_checks: Recommendation is not framed as definitive causality.

cases.notes_for_evaluator: This is the highest-level decision-support UAT case.
